# ApiPay Documentation

> ApiPay is a Vietnamese bank-transfer payment gateway API. This documentation covers integration, API reference, and guides.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/index): Integrate ApiPay into your system
- [Quick Start](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/quickstart): Get started with ApiPay in 5 minutes
- [Onboarding](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/onboarding): Complete guide to getting started with ApiPay
- [Subscription & Billing](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/subscription): Manage your ApiPay subscription and billing

## Banking & Payments

- [Bank Accounts](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/banking): Connect and manage your Vietnamese bank accounts to receive payments via ApiPay
- [Sandbox & Live Test](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/sandbox): Test payments and webhooks safely — no real money moves
- [Dashboard Guide](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/dashboard): Navigate and use your ApiPay dashboard effectively
- [Connect Banks](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/connect-banks): Link your Vietnamese bank account to start receiving payments via ApiPay
- [Payment Speaker](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/payment-speaker): Turn any phone, tablet, or computer into a real-time bank transfer voice announcement speaker for free
- [Custom Domains](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/custom-domains): Use your own domain for the ApiPay payment page
- [Passkeys](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/passkeys): Sign in to ApiPay faster with Face ID, fingerprint, or a device passkey
- [Affiliates](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/affiliates): Share ApiPay, track referrals, and manage commissions from the dashboard

## Integrations

- [Web App](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/webapp): Integrate ApiPay into a custom web app with SDK-style JavaScript and Python helpers.
- [WooCommerce](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/woocommerce): Install and configure the ApiPay WooCommerce payment gateway.
- [Vibe Code](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/vibe-code): Generate an ApiPay integration prompt for AI coding assistants.
- [WHMCS](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/whmcs): Install and configure the ApiPay WHMCS payment gateway module.
- [HostBill](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/integrations/hostbill): Install and configure the ApiPay HostBill payment gateway module.

## API Reference

- [Authentication](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/authentication): API authentication guide
- [Payment Requests](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/payment-requests): API for creating and managing payment links
- [Webhooks](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/webhooks): Receive real-time payment notifications
- [Banks](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/banks): API for connecting and managing client bank accounts
- [Metrics](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api/metrics): API for retrieving transaction metrics and analytics

## Interactive API Reference

- [API Reference](https://docs.apipay.vn/en/api-reference): Interactive API documentation with try-it console
